name: Priyanka Delivery Planning for WooCommerce
author: priyankachaklasiya

sections.description:
Priyanka Delivery Planning adds a focused delivery-planning experience to WooCommerce checkout. Customers can choose an available delivery date, time window and parcel profile, with optional express service. Store managers can configure schedules, blackout dates, postcode routing and fees from a dedicated admin workspace.

Features

  • Delivery date selection with configurable booking horizon.
  • Delivery time slots with weekday rules and slot fees.
  • Holiday and blackout date blocking.
  • Daily cutoff time.
  • Exact postcode and prefix postcode routing.
  • Express delivery surcharge.
  • Customer parcel profiles with optional fees.
  • Checkout field mode or popup mode.
  • Responsive customer-facing interface.
  • Delivery information stored on WooCommerce orders.
  • Delivery information included in WooCommerce order emails.
  • Delivery information available to supported PDF invoice extensions.
  • Delivery fee lines for slot, parcel handling and express service.
  • Delivery analytics dashboard.
  • HPOS compatibility declaration.
  • Secure admin save actions, nonces, capability checks and sanitization.

Source code

The plugin source code is included in the distribution. Human-readable JavaScript source is available in src/js/admin.js, with the corresponding runtime asset in assets/js/admin.js. No external build tool is required to install the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the Priyanka Delivery Planning ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate Priyanka Delivery Planning for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Priyanka Delivery Planning > Scheduler.
  5. Configure the customer experience, time slots, holidays, postcode rules, parcel profiles and fees.
  6. Place a test WooCommerce order and verify the delivery information in the order, email and supported invoice PDF.
sections.faq:
Can I use a popup instead of checkout fields?

Yes. Choose Selection popup in Priyanka Delivery Planning > Scheduler > Customer experience.

Are delivery fees added to the WooCommerce total?

Yes. Configured slot, parcel and express fees are added as separate WooCommerce fee lines.

Does Priyanka Delivery Planning edit WooCommerce core files?

No. Priyanka Delivery Planning uses WordPress and WooCommerce hooks and APIs.
